home.metaTitle: Rabotka Business - the next-generation ATS for hiring in Africa
home.metaDescription: Complete recruitment software: job posts written and published everywhere, CVs read and ranked for each role, a pipeline followed as a team, video interviews and shared reports.

features.title: A complete ATS, from job post to contract
features.text: Rabotka Business brings together everything a hire needs: publish the job, sort applications, meet the best and decide as a team.
features.heading: Pick a tool, see what it does
features.headingText: The tools follow the order of a hire: from the job post that attracts candidates to the hired candidate's contract.

about.metaDescription: Rabotka Business is Rabotka's hiring platform for companies and organisations: an ATS built for the African job market.
about.title: Hiring for African organisations, finally equipped
about.text: Rabotka connects people looking for work with those who hire, all the way to WhatsApp. Rabotka Business is its workspace for companies, institutions and organisations: a complete ATS, built for the African job market.
about.heading: Three beliefs behind every feature

beliefs.title: The right candidate often already exists
beliefs.text: They're in the pile of CVs, in your mailbox or on WhatsApp. Our job: make sure they no longer go unnoticed.

beliefs.title: A hire is decided as a team
beliefs.text: The hiring manager, HR, management: everyone should see the same candidates and give their opinion in the same place.

beliefs.title: Tools made for here
beliefs.text: Your country's official documents, mobile money payments, candidates reached where they are: on their phone.

about.whereText: The documents required, the cities and where your jobs are published are your country's; your plan is paid by mobile money, in your currency.

contact.metaDescription: Contact the Rabotka Business team: a demo, a question about your account or your hiring.

contact.text: A demo, a question about your account or getting set up: our team will answer.
contact.newText: Request a 30-minute demo: we get back to you within one business day to show you Rabotka on your roles.
contact.clientText: Sign in and open “Help” in your workspace: your request goes straight to our team, with its follow-up.
contact.directText: By email, by phone or at our offices.

ats.title: All of hiring in one pipeline
ats.text: Rabotka Business isn't just a job board: it's complete recruitment software. Each candidate moves from the job being posted all the way to the contract, and nothing gets lost along the way.

spotlight.title: Your interviews, from video call to report
spotlight.text: The call opens in Rabotka, everyone's voice becomes text, and the report writes itself while you move on to something else.

trust.title: Your data and candidates' data, protected
trust.text: Hiring with Rabotka also means knowing what is read, kept and deleted.

audiences.title: For every kind of organisation
audiences.text: From legal status to supporting documents, Rabotka adapts to the nature of your organisation.
audiences.otherText: Start-ups, cooperatives, economic interest groups, associations, foundations: open your account, we'll help you along.

countriesFaq.q: In which countries is Rabotka Business available?
countriesFaq.a: Today: {list}. The documents required, the cities offered and where your jobs are published are your country's; subscriptions are paid by mobile money, in your country's currency.

countries.title: Available in {count} African countries
countries.text: Each organisation hires in its own country: its documents, its cities, and a subscription paid by mobile money in its currency.

demoBlock.text: A member of our team shows you how to publish, sort and hire with Rabotka Business, on the roles you need to fill.

promises.title: 30 minutes, by video or phone
promises.text: Enough to see what matters to you: publishing a job, sorting applications, organising interviews.

promises.title: On your real roles
promises.text: Bring a role you need to fill: we start from your needs and your candidates, not a ready-made example.

promises.title: A reply within one business day
promises.text: A member of our team gets back to you to set a time that suits you.

connections.title: Rabotka at the heart of your hiring
connections.text: Your candidates come from LinkedIn, Google, WhatsApp or your mailbox; your interviews go into your calendar, your reports to your team. Everything is decided in Rabotka.
